messages:
jana: Heads-up — customer 'Bridgewater Data' asked us to evaluate nyx-8b as a candidate for low-latency on-device summarization. They care about token-level latency and hallucination rate. Can we triage and recommend a quantization path?
cheng: +1. Need to confirm target hardware and seq length. Do we have their P50 latency SLO?
lia-k: Customer target: <120ms P95 for 256 tokens on dedicated T4-like edge. They'll accept slightly higher if cost drops. Use-case: live call summarization, lots of short prompts + incremental context.
samir: Ok. First pass: run quant smoke (int8 and q4f16) with our prefix caching enabled. Focus on end-to-end latency including KV cache warmup. I can provision a small Dedicated pool for realistic numbers.
jana: Priority: P2 (customer pilot) unless quantation causes large quality drop. Owner: cheng for quality checks, samir for perf. Lia to coordinate comms.
cheng: Plan for evaluations:
- functional smoke (generate on curated prompt set)
- quantitative: perplexity on held-out set, ROUGE/F1 for summarization tasks
- hallucination regression: two-shot fact-check suite (from evals repo)
- semantic similarity: embeddings drift test (cosine < delta)
- priming sensitivity for short prompts (since use-case is short/streaming)
I'll run baseline (fp16) vs qint8 vs q4f16.
qa-bot: Reminder: use eval harness commit a1b2c3 (v2 prompts) for consistency.
samir: Smoke commands (ops):
```
# quick smoke
run_quant_smoke --model nyx-8b --configs qint8,q4f16 --seq 256 --warmup 20 --batch 1
```
I'll also run with continuous batching off to mimic low-latency client.
lia-k: Timeline? Customer demo in 6 business days. Can we get a quick verdict in 3 days?
cheng: 3 days is tight but doable for smoke + basic regression. Full eval will take longer. I'll prioritize hallucination and ROUGE. Expect preliminary notes in ~48h.
samir: I'll spin up a 2-GPU dedicated pool and run latency loops. Ops-bot will post deployment once ready.
ops-bot: Provision request received: 2x a10g-like, project=nyx-pilot, ttl=72h.
jana: Checklist for this thread (quick):
- [ ] run fp16 baseline (cheng)
- [ ] run qint8 + q4f16 smoke (cheng)
- [ ] perf loops on Dedicated (samir)
- [ ] hallucination check (cheng)
- [ ] embed-drift check (cheng)
- [ ] customer sync + expectations (lia-k)
- [ ] decide rollout config (batching/caching/quant) (jana + samir)
cheng: Quick note: watch for tokenization differences — nyx uses byte-level BPE, need to match eval tokenization. Also enable deterministic sampling for regression runs.
lia-k: I'll draft the customer-facing summary after the 48h milestone.
samir: If qint8 latency meets SLO but quality degrades slightly, recommend hybrid: qint8 for 1-2 token loops, fall back to fp16 for long sequences. We have a fallback policy available in runtime.
cheng: Agreed. Also we'll capture model-calibration notes (temperature, top_k) to avoid generation artifacts post-quant.
qa-bot: Test run queued: nyx-8b fp16 baseline (job 5523).
jana: Great. Let's reconvene in-thread with initial numbers. Tag me if any blockers. :thumbsup:
